market.headline: No clear trend
market.read: The index is caught between its major averages, which is the condition trend-following does worst in. Breadth is mixed — 42 of 87 tracked names above their own 50-day. Long bonds and high-yield credit are both down over 60 sessions: conditions tightening and risk appetite retreating together.

macro.headline: Rates rising and credit widening together
macro.short: Long bonds and high-yield credit are both down over 60 sessions: conditions tightening and risk appetite retreating together.
macro.read: Long bonds down 0.7% and high-yield credit down 2.9% over 60 sessions. Both proxies moving against risk at once is the most straightforwardly hostile of the four backdrops: money is getting more expensive and simultaneously harder to borrow. Nothing here is specific to any one ticker — it is the weather every position is being held in.
macro.note: The rates leg of this is small enough to be drift — the reading is effectively being carried by the other one.
macro.caveat: TLT and HYG are proxies for rates and credit, not measurements of them — each carries its own duration, supply and fund-flow effects. Sixty sessions of realised moves, and nothing here forecasts the next sixty.

market.caveat: A description of the tape as it stands, measured across the 87 tickers this site tracks — not a forecast, and 87 names is not the whole market.
